instruction: Change Screen Blank timeout to 10 minutes in Power settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

The expected value of 600 (seconds) correctly represents 10 minutes, matching the instruction requirement.
Output parsing handles the 'uint32 N' gsettings format correctly by splitting on whitespace and taking the last token.
Initial state sets idle-delay to 300 (5 minutes), which is ≠ 600, so the evaluator correctly rejects the pre-task state (good negative control resistance).
Metric performs an exact equality check (idle_delay == 600) which is the appropriate comparison for this discrete setting.
